list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "device", predicate: (r) => true, start: -30d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "midea")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "operating_mode")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "midea")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "indoor_setpoint")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 1.8 + 32.0 }))
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
